texts.li: [camp] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, from the camp, came up to the gate this morning with a {TALE} and asked for the colony's doctor. The camp has been watching {A_nameDef} at work, {X_nameDef} says, and nobody among them knows half as much.
[camp] The camp's people have been talking about the colony's doctor. This morning {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} walked over with a {TALE}, cap in hand, and asked whether {A_nameDef} would take a look.

[!camp,known,lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has walked a long way with a {TALE}, because people on the road say the colony's sickroom turns nobody away. {X_nameDef} asks whether {A_nameDef} would see to it.

[!camp,known,!lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has come to the gate with a {TALE}. Travellers say the colony's hospital is a good one, {X_nameDef} explains, and the nearest doctor on {X_possessive} road is days away.

[!camp,renowned] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has come a long way with a {TALE}, on the strength of the colony's name: across the region they say there's no better place to fall ill. {X_nameDef} would like to see {A_nameDef}, if there's time.
[!camp] {X_nameDef}, a traveller of {FACTION}, stopped at the colony with a {TALE} and asked for its doctor by name: {A_nameDef}. Someone on the road had told {X_objective} to.

li.label: {A_nameDef} sees to {X_objective} (1 medicine)
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} sat {X_nameDef} down, looked at the {TALE} properly and treated it. {X_nameDef} went away with instructions and a lighter step, and {FACTION} will hear where the help came from.

outcomes.li: [camp] {A_nameDef} went over to the camp with a bag and treated {X_nameDef}'s {TALE} by their fire, with half the camp watching. They've been calling {A_objective} "the doctor" ever since, as if there were no other.
[lowtech] {A_nameDef} ground something bitter, wrapped something warm, and sent {X_nameDef} off with instructions for the {TALE} and a pouch of herbs for the road.
[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} examined {X_nameDef}, treated the {TALE} and wrote out what to do for the next few days in a clear hand. {X_nameDef} folded the paper as if it were money.

li.label: Medicine for the road (1)
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} handed over a dose of medicine and some advice about the {TALE}, and {X_nameDef} went on {X_possessive} way grateful.

li.label: A word of advice, nothing more
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} told {X_nameDef} what would help with the {TALE} and wished {X_objective} well. The medicine stays on the shelf.
